readers.reasoning: omp_target_is_present returns true when device_num is the host or ptr has corresponding storage on the device. After target enter data map(to: a) the storage is mapped (or the device is the host), so present must be nonzero; observed 0 is wrong. After exit data release the reference count drops to zero, so 0 is correct on a non-host device. c_loc of a target array is valid.

target enter data map(to: a) creates corresponding storage in the device data environment of the default device, so omp_target_is_present must return true (nonzero) afterwards; it also returns true if the device is the host. After exit data release the reference count drops to zero and the storage is removed, so 0 is correct only for that second print. Observed 0 after enter data is therefore wrong. c_loc of a target array of interoperable type is valid Fortran 2008, and the explicit interface comes from omp_lib.

map(to: a) on target enter data is a map-entering construct on a variable with no corresponding storage, so a corresponding storage block is created (it may share storage with the original under unified memory, but it is still created and present). omp_target_is_present must then return true after enter data, so present=0 is wrong. After exit data with release the reference count drops to zero and it is removed.

After target enter data map(to: a) the array has corresponding storage in the device data environment, so omp_target_is_present must return true. No requires unified_shared_memory is present, so the mapping is not elided. Reporting 0 after enter data is wrong.
